title: Karyo splice
description: A named what-if over a Karyo model: proposed changes (add, connect, disconnect, remove, rename, move, replace, group) drawn in place on a plate. Lives at <project>/karyo/splices/<id>.splice.json. Semantics: docs/MODEL.md, Splices. validateSplice (src/model/splice.ts) checks this shape and what it means.

model.description: The model file the splice was made against (repo-relative)

commit.description: The commit it was made at; null when unknown or uncommitted

scene.description: The scene (plate) it was drawn on

view.description: Where the splice lives: the view it was opened in (and last saved in), which reopening restores. Owned by the UI; a structure board writes the keys below. Absent (an older splice): it opens at the top level.

nav.description: Group navigation: one card per group (entered level by level) or every card

at.description: The group entered (null: the overview); a group the splice proposes counts

path.description: The group labels from the top down to `at`, as the breadcrumb said them when saved

positions.description: Cards dragged inside the splice (the real view's layout is never written)

ops.description: Applied in order; later ops may name nodes earlier ops add

ref.description: A node: its id (preferred) or its label

groupRef.description: A group: its id (preferred) or its label

nodeKind.description: service, function, store, queue, external, actor, or a kit's node kind (docs/KITS.md)

id.description: splice.<slug>; derived from the label when omitted

group.description: Default: the group of the node it is placed next to

between.description: [a, b]: a → b (or b → a) becomes a → new → b

before.description: X with one caller c (or none): c → X becomes c → new → X. X with several callers: just new → X (a step that also calls X)

after.description: X with one outgoing relationship X → d (or none): X → new → d (just X → new). X fanning out to several: just X → new (a step X also calls)

oneOf.description: Remove a node (a ghost), or with group a group this splice proposes, with every card in it
Rename a node, or with group a group

Swap X for Y: Y takes over every relationship of X, in and out; X stays as a removed ghost, its relationships as rerouted ghosts. Later references to X (in this splice, or in splices combined after it) follow to Y.

with.description: Y: a new node (kind, category and group default to X's), or a node that exists

oneOf.description: Propose a new group: optionally its first card, and one relationship between the group and a node. The relationship goes to the group's entry: its first card, else a placeholder card that stands for the group until a card is proposed into it (the first one takes over its relationships).

id.description: splice.<slug>; derived from the label when omitted

parent.description: The group it sits in (none: the top level)

first.description: Its first card (its group is the new group)

to.description: A node (or a group this splice proposes)

dir.description: in: to → the group (the group is an outlet of to); out: the group → to
